# Vendored dependency

`ArduinoJson.h` is the unmodified ArduinoJson 7.4.3 single-header release by Benoit Blanchon, used by the device API adapter. License: MIT; the copyright and license notice are retained in the header.

- Source: https://github.com/bblanchon/ArduinoJson/releases/download/v7.4.3/ArduinoJson-v7.4.3.h
- SHA-256: `ab5fbb8268b846b5f4bc5a5fee11bb2c96f7b8b846f5bef6540afb6a9cc76a5b`

Update the pinned header, hash and portable API tests together. This header is compiled directly from the repository and is separate from the Arduino library archives installed by `tools/fetch_sources.py`.
